meta.name: run-train
meta.description: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按标准流程启动深度学习训练并留存完整运行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想安全地运行深度学习训练并自动留存日志与指标。
copy.tagline_en: Run deep learning training with a standard flow and keep full evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to safely run deep learning training with automated logging and metrics.

howto.what: 装上后，当你给出已选定的训练命令和运行模式（启动验证、短跑验证、完整启动或恢复），Claude 会保守地执行该命令，并在 train_outputs/ 文件夹中生成运行记录与报告，涵盖命令、配置、日志、检查点、状态和指标。
howto.when: 当训练命令已选定，研究者要求做启动验证、短跑验证、完整启动等训练运行时触发。不用于环境准备或探索性实验。

say.text: 短跑验证一下，只训练 100 步，把指标记录下来。
say.note: 短时间运行用于确认训练流程可跑通。

say.text: 从最后一个 checkpoint 恢复完整训练，并继续跑完。
say.note: Claude 按恢复模式运行并记录日志和断点。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude conservatively executes a selected training command (startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume) and writes standardized artifacts to train_outputs/, including command, config, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a training command is already selected and the researcher asks for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume. Not for environment setup or exploratory sweeps.

say_en.text: Run startup verification: execute python train.py --config base.yaml.
say_en.note: Claude runs it and reports startup status.

say_en.text: Do a short-run verification: 100 steps only, record metrics.
say_en.note: A brief run to confirm the pipeline works.

say_en.text: Resume from the last checkpoint and continue to full completion.
